DISCHARGE SUMMARY Meridian Prairie Medical Center Transplant Surgery / Nephrology Unit: 6 West Transplant Bed 6W-14
Patient: Mahlet T. Gebremariam MRN E-0498127 DOB 07/02/2018 Admitted: 05/11/2071 Discharged: 05/14/2071 Attending: Dr. Osagie Nwankwo Endocrine consult: Dr. Lowell Frost Nephrology: Dr. Anneliese Bishop Coordinator: Dana Rice, RN Discharge Dx: *** Primary care: Dr. Ruth Kowalczyk
S: 52 yo woman with T2DM c/b diabetic kidney disease (microalbuminuria 2060 -> proteinuria 2066), CKD stage 4 since 02/21/2067, listed for deceased-donor kidney since mid-April 2067, adm 5/11 (Monday) for transplant after the call from the OPO at 04:10. Seen in clinic on the 4th (eGFR 4.7), 05/07/71 (pain 5/10, joint aches), 5/10 (pre-op). Husband Dawit Haile brought her, daughter Selam translating in the waiting area although the Tigrinya interpreter was booked for the consent. Feels "scared but ready". Denies fever, chest pain. Hx also: asthma (uses ProAir prn), HTN, IHD s/p CABG 01/17/2063, obesity, metabolic syndrome, miscarriage 2047, tubal ligation.
O: Adm: eGFR 6.2, glucose 99.1 mg/dL, pain 2/10. Post-op labs 05/12/2071: WBC 6.6, Hgb 12.5, glucose 80.1; 05/13/2071: WBC 6.1, Hgb 12.4, glucose 80.1 (same value twice, lab copy-forward?). Graft functioning, urine output good by POD 1. No Cushing features, no steroid hyperglycemia. Induction + tacrolimus injection (Prograf) on the day of surgery, switched to once daily extended-release oral tacrolimus (Envarsus 1 mg) on 5/13. Pain controlled with acetaminophen.
A: 1. ESRD/CKD 4 s/p deceased-donor kidney transplant 05/11/2071, good early graft function. 2. T2DM - glucose fine inpatient; high risk of post-transplant diabetes worsening on tacrolimus, endocrine to follow. Prediabetes label in chart is out of date. 3. IHD s/p CABG - continue antiplatelet + statin.
P: Meds on d/c: tacrolimus ER (Envarsus) 1 mg daily, clopidogrel 75 daily, simvastatin 20 nightly, metoprolol succinate 100 daily, nitroglycerin spray prn, diphenhydramine prn. STOP lisinopril and amlodipine (old list!). Insulin: none. Labs twice weekly, tacrolimus trough each visit. Clinic Mon 5/17? (coordinator to confirm) then every week. Endocrine last week of May. Social: lives 418 Corliss Avenue, Apt 3B, Minneapolis; transport arranged by case worker Marguerite Oduya of Harbor Light Resettlement. Arrived as a refugee from Eritrea via Sudan in 2054. Alien reg # on the transplant consent: A217-554-908.
